transcript.text: Good information from both of you. Let me make sure I have the full picture before I publish the schedule. Lt. Morgan, the refrigerated medical pallets need to unload at Dock 1 from 0800 to 1000, and since this is a time-limited temperature-controlled delivery, S7 requires the schedule's coordination line to identify a direct carrier contact. Please confirm you'll provide that carrier contact information so I can include it in the published schedule. SFC Patel, the engineering barrier pallets movement is set for South Yard from 1000 to 1200, and since the pallets weigh 4,800 pounds — above the 4,500-pound threshold — a spotter is required per the forklift inspection condition. That sequencing works: medical unload completes by 1000, then the barrier movement runs 1000 to 1200, both within the forklift's 0800–1200 availability window. Before I settle and publish, I need two things: Lt. Morgan, please add the Dock 1 appointment to the movement board and provide the direct carrier contact for the coordination line. SFC Patel, please ensure the motor-pool inspection log with the spotter requirement and South Yard reservation gets to operations. Once those board updates are made, I'll publish the final schedule.
